method: Every pair below was read off a page image rendered with pdf.js at 4x and checked by eye. No pair was taken from any parser's output, so the labels do not favour either side. When a source document is reissued its digest changes and scripts/parser-ab/fetch.ts refuses to proceed, which is the signal to re-verify the pages listed here.

sectionsNote: An IPID puts 'what is covered' and 'what is NOT covered' in two boxes side by side. If the columns interleave, a covered peril lands under the exclusions heading and the product answers the exact opposite of the truth, with a real citation. These entries check that each statement keeps the heading that governs it.
